title: ProShirt - Breathing Pattern Changed
visual_summary: Smart textile garment with textile sensors showing respiratory effort shifts.
narration_summary: Your overnight breathing pattern changed more than usual. Use your CPAP carefully and contact your provider if this continues.

start_scene_0_3s.description: ProShirt animation highlighting chest and abdominal expansion sensors.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Detects paradoxical breathing effort during obstructive airway events.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Confirms need for continuous pressure therapy to stabilize breathing.
